title: Transit Parking Status
description: v1 wiring contract (lane C packet W0; plan check C-8, queue item B-10) for one lot's transit/parking-zone status, read ONCE from one official source and applied identically to every option (so the transit/parking status cannot differ between options). The document is the serialized resolve_transit_parking_status(...) output of services/api/app/profile/transit_parking.py (TransitParkingStatus.to_dict()), wrapped in a version envelope. It carries the PLUTO transitzone classification VERBATIM (DCP's Transit Zones per the PLUTO Data Dictionary 26v1) or says the source is 'Check needed'. It states NO parking OUTCOME: applying the Zoning Resolution off-street parking rules to the zone (the number of spaces, a waiver, or an exemption) is a rule-engine / legal determination made by the engine (Lane A) and a qualified reviewer at G6, never here. There is deliberately no parking-outcome field.

contract_version.description: CLOSED enum of published transit_parking contract versions. 1.0.0 = lane C packet W0 initial shape. 1.1.0 (request D-2, D-090-R095) adds the missing_source_ref object (the Source-disclosure reference behind missing_source: its exact identifier, version and link). missing_source_ref is now a REQUIRED key on every document (object when check_needed, null when recorded) and the route always emits it; a document whose missing_source_ref is the non-null object declares 1.1.0 (the version-binding allOf below), while a document with a null reference (every recorded status) may declare 1.0.0 or 1.1.0. The enum is append-only: new versions are admitted only by an accepted contract task that appends to it; 1.0.0 is retained for a recorded document carrying a null reference.

lot_bbl.description: The tax lot (10-digit BBL) this status is for. resolve_transit_parking_status runs once per BBL and every option reads that one object.

status.description: transit_parking STATUSES: recorded = PLUTO has a usable transit-zone value; check_needed = no usable value (the reason is in detail). Neither states a parking requirement.

status_label.description: The display label, tied one-to-one to status. 'Check needed' is the plan section 8a wording, copied exactly.

transit_zone.description: The verbatim PLUTO transitzone text (for example 'Outer Transit Zone'), or null when check_needed. Passed through, never re-interpreted.

source.description: A site_fact city_dataset source for PLUTO (dataset, dataset version, retrieved_at, query_ref, provenance_refs), or the checked source when no value was found; may be null.

detail.description: The one line shown beside every option (plan section 5a). It states the legal boundary: the zone is DCP's classification; applying the ZR parking rules to it is the rule engine's job, not this layer's.

missing_source.description: The source behind the field to check when check_needed, named in readable words only (DCP Transit Zones); null when recorded. The exact dataset identifier, version and link live in missing_source_ref (the Source disclosure), never on the face (owner decision D-090-R095; request D-2).

missing_source_ref.description: Structured reference to the source named in missing_source, for the Source disclosure (request D-2, D-090-R095): the exact identifier, version and link where available. The face shows missing_source (a readable name and what to check) only. REQUIRED on every document and the route always emits it: null when there is no source to reference (a recorded status), the object below when check_needed names a source. A non-null object binds contract_version to 1.1.0 (the version-binding allOf below).

_expected_failure.description: FIXTURE-ONLY annotation stating the intended defect of an invalid fixture (packages/contracts README convention). Producers NEVER emit this key; it is allowed (optional) so an invalid fixture fails only for its stated defect under additionalProperties:false.

allOf.description: status, status_label, transit_zone, missing_source and missing_source_ref move together. recorded carries a transit zone, no missing source and a null reference; check_needed carries no transit zone, names the source to check and carries the structured reference object.

Version binding (request D-2, D-090-R095): a document carrying a non-null missing_source_ref (the structured Source disclosure introduced in 1.1.0) declares contract_version 1.1.0. A null reference (every recorded status) leaves the version unconstrained, so 1.0.0 stays valid for it. Expressed as anyOf (not if/then) so the stdlib and engine validators agree: either missing_source_ref is null, or contract_version is 1.1.0.

missing_source_ref.description: The Source-disclosure reference behind missing_source (contract 1.1.0, request D-2 / D-090-R095). Carries the official dataset title and, where available, its exact identifier, publisher, version and link. Every declared key is present; a key that does not apply is explicitly null, so absence is a visible statement. 'components' names the sub-datasets a single named source is composed of, each with its own id. This is the disclosure-side reference ONLY; the face shows missing_source.

dataset.description: The official dataset title (for example 'Transit Zones').

dataset_id.description: The official dataset identifier (for example the NYC Open Data four-by-four '6ztr-wgff'); null when the source exposes none.

publisher.description: The publishing agency (for example 'Department of City Planning (DCP)'); null when not recorded.

dataset_version.description: The dataset release identifier where the source exposes one; null when it does not.

url.description: A link to the dataset landing page or record; null when none is recorded.

components.description: OPTIONAL sub-datasets a single named source is composed of (for example the Greater Transit Zone and Appendix I layers behind DCP Transit Zones), each with its own title and identifier.
